name: Prefer fresh muscle over fatigued muscle
description: When systemic readiness is high but the intended primary muscle is locally fatigued, and a fresh alternative with comparable program value exists, re-score the session candidates instead of defaulting to the intended muscle.
explanation: Systemic readiness is high, but the planned target is locally fatigued.
NOT YET WIRED: no code in TKI-1/TKI-2 executes this rescoring. This rule is knowledge-layer only until a future session-ranking milestone (TKI-4) consumes it.

name: The session selector should optimize the week, not merely rotate names
description: Session selection should be driven by goal relevance, weekly stimulus debt, local readiness, program balance, days since trained, systemic readiness, recent performance, schedule, exercise availability, and user constraints - in that order.
explanation: This is the target session-selection hierarchy for a future milestone. TKI-1/TKI-2 expose the ledger and readiness data this hierarchy will eventually consume; they do not rank sessions.

name: A generated workout must pass consistency invariants before publication
description: Goal consistency, weekly balance, local readiness, systemic-dose consistency, historical-dose consistency, progression consistency, recovery protection, and explainability must all hold before a session is published.
explanation: Documented here for provenance; enforcement is a future milestone (TKI-6). No current recommendation path is gated by this rule.
